name: PDF Cover Cards
changes: Cards without a PDF now show an image from the note as the cover, so PDF scans and photos fit on one shelf.
Turn this off with the view option "Show images when there is no PDF".
tip: Add #page=N to a PDF link to show another page as the card cover.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. PDF Cover Cards is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
